scope: Independent stdlib identity, runtime and raw preflight evidence audit; no production verifier/evaluate imports, model execution or re-tokenization.
limits: Hashes and recorded access prove an internally consistent artifact chain, not independent OS access surveillance. The input test was already inspected in prior studies.
Raw GPU samples show the same device UUID throughout; they are device-level samples, not exclusive process accounting.
preflight engine_overlap_seconds is the sum of pairwise HTTP-stage interval intersections, with duplicate temporal counting; not wall-clock simultaneous GPU execution or GPU kernel overlap.
Preflight memory is not the fixed formal memory allocation: actual KV differs by startup; formal per-role ranges retained.
Health prefix_cache=true conflicts with actual engine launch no-enable-prefix-caching and effective runtime false.

Per-cell finished.json cleanup receipts are checked but not individually SHA-bound by freeze.json; freeze binds complete->plan->start/warmup/raw evidence. Existing verifier rechecks finished.json separately.
Historical prediction mapping and scored goodput are independently audited by sibling metrics task.
